tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// klu gtor bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// klu gtor gtong bar 'dod pas/ dkar gtor gtsang ma bshams la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bya/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang rung du bsgom/ gtor ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ma dag pa bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rin po che'i snod rgya chen po bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ gtor ma las klu rnams kyis ci 'dod pa thogs pa med par 'byung bar bsam/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang la gnod pa thams cad spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu lunta// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye che dang tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnams dag ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gatstsha ya/ ā gatstsha ya/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhurbhu wa phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas so so la padma'i gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛhṇe daṃ zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ swā hās zhabs bsil/ puṣpaṃ swā hās me tog dhū paṃ swā hās bdug spos/ dī paṃ swā hās mar me/ gandhaṃ swā hās dri/ nai wi dye swā hās zhal zas phul nas/ klu thams cad kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ma hā hi li phruṃ phraṃ phraṃ phraṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pas gtor snod re re la gsum gsum dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭhā dzūṃ phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod pas phul nas/ ye dharmā he pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba datte ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu bdag la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyur cig gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyis shig ces brjod nas/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa la swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nag po'i rigs kyi klu gzhan thams cad bskrad par bsam/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar gtong*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ klu'i gtor ma rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las byung ba bzhin/ chos rje sa skya pas mdzad pa'i phyag len 'phags pas yi ger bkod pa'o//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
